predict.question: You have 24 minutes to practice piano. Each eight-minute work block needs four minutes of setup first. Counting only complete blocks, how many minutes of actual work do you get?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: A Mind for Numbers describes building practiced chunks that can be used in larger tasks.
modelBoundary: Small blocks yield {A}; larger blocks {B}. Larger chunks spread each fixed setup over more useful work.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is workflow arithmetic, not a measured working-memory capacity or learning curve.
